topic: レン's film photos and a secret
title_jp: {秘密|ひみつ}の{一枚|いちまい}
text_title: レンのインスタ{投稿|とうこう|post (social media)|3}
context: Sunday 13 December: レン posts the developed film photos from the snowy day he and アルちゃん first met. His sister {葵|あおい} asks who he went with; he answers '{秘密|ひみつ}', then tells アルちゃん it doesn't mean anything bad.
scene: Sunday evening. レン posts last week's film photos online. His sister comments. You read the comments, and what he answers her.

phrases.jp: え、{何|なに}これ、{素敵|すてき|lovely, wonderful|4}！
phrases.en: Wait, what is this? It's lovely!
phrases.note: A warm, slightly grown-up reaction. Younger people also say エモい.

phrases.jp: {写真|しゃしん}とか{動画|どうが|video|4}とか、よく{投稿する|とうこうする|to post (online)|3}の？
phrases.en: Do you post photos and videos and stuff a lot?
phrases.note: AとかBとか: examples, not a full list.
The everyday 'same here'. Stretch the vowel when you mean it.

phrases.jp: いいね、{押しといた|おしといた|to press (pressed in advance)|3}よ。
phrases.note: {押|お}しといた = {押|お}しておいた (casual contraction).

phrases.jp: マジで？{全然|ぜんぜん}{知らなかった|しらなかった}！
phrases.note: マジで = {本当|ほんとう}に. Fine with friends, never at work.

dialogue_setting: Sunday evening under the kotatsu. You scroll レン's new post on your phone, with its comments.

dialogue.speaker: Post
dialogue.jp: {先週|せんしゅう}の{日曜日|にちようび}。{雪|ゆき}の{喫茶店|きっさてん|old-style coffee shop|3}とか、{古い|ふるい}{映画館|えいがかん|cinema|4}とか。
dialogue.en: Last Sunday. The coffee shop in the snow, the old cinema, things like that.

dialogue.speaker: Post
dialogue.jp: フィルムだから、{現像|げんぞう|developing (film)|2}に{一週間|いっしゅうかん}かかった。{待つ|まつ}{時間|じかん}も{不思議|ふしぎ|strange, mysterious|4}と{楽しい|たのしい}。
dialogue.en: It's film, so developing took a week. Strangely, even the waiting is fun.

dialogue.speaker: Sister's comment
dialogue.jp: お{兄ちゃん|にいちゃん}、{珍しく|めずらしく|unusually, for once|3}{楽しそう|たのしそう}ｗ {誰|だれ}と{行った|いった}の〜？
dialogue.en: Big brother, you look happy for once lol. Who did you go with~?

dialogue.speaker: Friend's comment
dialogue.jp: {色|いろ}がエモい！{加工|かこう|editing (photos)|3}とかしてないの？
dialogue.en: The colours are so moody! Didn't you edit them or something?
dialogue.note: エモい (slang) = moving, nostalgic. From English 'emotional'.

dialogue.speaker: レン's reply
dialogue.jp: してないよ。フィルムの{色|いろ}、{そのまま||as it is, unchanged|4}。
dialogue.en: Nope. The film's colours, just as they are.

dialogue.speaker: Your comment
dialogue.jp: {素敵|すてき|lovely, wonderful|4}！{雪|ゆき}の{日|ひ}の{写真|しゃしん}、いいね。
dialogue.en: Lovely! The snowy-day photos are great.

listening.intro: A minute later, レン sends you a voice message. Type what he says.

lines.jp: {秘密|ひみつ|secret|4}って{書いた|かいた}けど、{変な|へんな}{意味|いみ}じゃないよ。
lines.en: I wrote 'secret', but I don't mean it in a bad way.

grammar.form: noun: + とか ({映画|えいが}とか, {加工|かこう}とか) · list: A とか B とか ({喫茶店|きっさてん}とか{映画館|えいがかん}とか)
grammar.explanation: とか gives examples without a full list, like や, but it's casual. It can also follow just one thing, meaning '…or something', which softens questions and invitations. や can't do that. In emails and with superiors, use や or など.

examples.jp: {週末|しゅうまつ}は{掃除|そうじ}とか{洗濯|せんたく}とかで{忙しい|いそがしい}。
examples.en: At weekends I'm busy with cleaning, laundry and stuff.

examples.jp: {今度|こんど}、お{茶|ちゃ}とかどう？
examples.en: How about tea or something next time?

quiz.question: {休み|やすみ}の{日|ひ}は、{映画|えいが}＿＿{見て|みて}ゆっくりしてる。
quiz.en: On my days off I take it easy, watching films and stuff.
quiz.explain: Noun + とか: one example of what you do, 'films or something'.

quiz_more.question: ケーキとかクッキー＿＿、{甘い|あまい}ものが{好き|すき}。
quiz_more.en: I like sweet things like cake and cookies.
quiz_more.explain: AとかBとか: the second とか closes the list of examples.

quiz_more.question: （{部長|ぶちょう}へのメール）{会議|かいぎ}では、{予算|よさん|budget|3}＿＿{日程|にってい|schedule, dates|3}について{話しました|はなしました}。
quiz_more.en: (Email to the manager) At the meeting we discussed the budget, the schedule and so on.
quiz_more.explain: In a work email use や: とか is too casual.

kanji.where: The bookmark button under レン's post.
kanji.breakdown: {保存|ほぞん}: 保 keep, protect + 存 exist → 'keep it existing': save.
kanji.related: {保存|ほぞん}しました = Saved. Also on food: {冷蔵保存|れいぞうほぞん} = keep refrigerated.

tip.title: Hinting without saying
tip.body: Many Japanese people only press いいね in public and keep real reactions for private messages. {匂わせ|におわせ} is slang for a post that hints at a secret partner without saying it. A one-word {秘密|ひみつ} under a photo for two is a classic {匂わせ|におわせ}.

challenge.prompt: レン on LINE: 「{葵|あおい}には{今度|こんど}、ちゃんと{話す|はなす}つもり。」 You reply that there's no hurry at all, and let's go to a film or something again. One part is wrong.

parts.jp: {全然|ぜんぜん}{急がなくて|いそがなくて}いいよ。

parts.why: や can't stand after just one thing before a verb. 'A film or something' → {映画|えいが}とか.

challenge.model_answer: うん、{全然|ぜんぜん}{急がなくて|いそがなくて|to hurry|4}いいよ。また{映画|えいが}とか{行こう|いこう}ね。
challenge.explanation: {急|いそ}がなくていい means 'you don't have to hurry', and {全然|ぜんぜん} makes it 'not at all'. {映画|えいが}とか keeps the invitation light: a film, or something like that. ね at the end makes it warm.

vocab.note: 不 not + 思 think + {議|ぎ} discuss → beyond thought. {不思議|ふしぎ}と = strangely.
{珍|めずら}しく〜 = for once. {珍|めずら}しいね! = That's not like you!
{秘密|ひみつ}にする = to keep secret. Kids say ないしょ.
Also: そのままでいい = it's fine as it is.
Warmer than きれい: people, places, gifts.
動 move + 画 picture. YouTube is {動画|どうが}, TV is not.
{投稿|とうこう}する = to post. {投|とう} throw + {稿|こう} manuscript.
Buttons and doors. いいねを{押|お}す = to like a post.

kanji_study.parts: 扌 hand radical + 殳 an arm holding a tool → a hand swinging to throw: throw, send in.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 設 (set up): 設 has 言 words on the left, 投 has 扌 a hand.

kanji_study.parts: 言 words + 義 what is right → words about what is right: discussion, debate.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 儀 (ceremony): 儀 has 亻 a person on the left, 議 has 言 words.

items.jp: ストーリー、{見たよ|みたよ}。

items.note: {鍵|かぎ} key + アカウント.

extras.title: Quick reactions
extras.title_jp: すぐ{使える|つかえる}リアクション

items.note: Slang. Very common among young people.
For something too cute or moving.
